messages:
maya: Hey team — AcmeOps saying summaries started getting an extra preface after last night's canary deploy. They pasted two examples and say it's consistent in prod since ~02:00 UTC. Asking for a quick triage and minimal repro request.

dmitri: Ack. Which model variant and rollout id did the canary touch?

maya: rollout id `r-2026-03-16-canary-3`. Model: `redwood/gptx-4-1-sharded` (v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2). They say behavior change only for 'order_summary' route (customer-owned prompt templates).

ella: Can we get their prompt + full request body (headers removed) and any prompt logs? We need to see whether prefix injected at prompt layer or served by model response. Also, sample API response with tokens would help.

maya: Pasted minimal example from customer (redacted):
```json
{
  "prompt_template": "Summarize the order for customer: {{order_items}}",
  "input": "1x red sneakers, 2x socks",
  "max_tokens": 120,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
And their returned text: "Note: Here's the order summary...\n- red sneakers\n- socks x2\nTotal: $123"

kyle: Did they use Redwood's prompt-formatting helper or are they passing a preformatted string? If they were using the helper we changed behaviour around system prompts in this rollout.

maya: They say they pass the template string through our SDK helper `ri.formatPrompt(template, data)`. They swear nothing changed on their side.

support-bot: New ticket created: CS-4729 (Escalation). Priority: P2. Assigned to customer-success.

ella: OK — next steps for repro: 1) Request customer to 1) send one full raw HTTP request/response pair (no API key) 2) include the SDK version and commit hash 3) share prompt logs from our side (we can query) for the times they saw the behavior.

dmitri: I can pull server-side prompt logs if they grant access window. Maya, can you get their timeframe (first saw at 02:07 UTC, repeated at 02:15 and 03:02 per their notes)? I'll tail the logs for r-2026-03-16-canary-3.

maya: Yep, they gave the three hits with request ids: `req_9a1`, `req_b2f`, `req_c3d`. I'll ask them for the raw HTTP pairs and SDK version.

kyle: If this is tied to the SDK helper then possibility: our format helper started injecting a safety preface when max_tokens <= 150 (we introduced a system-preserve flag). Could be a bug.

ella: To speed repro internally, can someone craft a minimal local repro calling the same model + SDK commit? I can spin up a small harness. If I can reproduce locally with SDK commit `v1.12.4` and model `v2.3.2`, we can confirm it's on our side.

dmitri: I'm pulling the prompt logs now for those request ids. ETA ~20m. If logs show the prompt already had the "Note:" preface then it's likely SDK/formatting. If the prompt is clean but model output has preface, then model/regression.

maya: Customer replied quickly with the raw request body for `req_b2f` and their SDK version `1.12.4`. They say they elevated to engineering on their side too.

ella: Good. When you paste the raw request/response, wrap any API keys and PII. Also include response token-level breakdown if available. We'll look for exact token sequences.

dmitri: Pulled logs: for `req_b2f` our ingress shows prompt without "Note:" preface. The model response begins with the tokens: ["Note", ":", "Here's", "..."]. So it looks like the model produced it.

kyle: That suggests model/regression after v2.3.2 kernels or a prompt-handling change in the runtime. Ella — can you run an internal call pinned to previous binary (v2.3.1) vs v2.3.2? We should A/B to confirm.

ella: On it. I'll run deterministic calls (temp=0) with the exact request body. Posting results when ready.

maya: Customer appreciates the quick loop. They asked if we can prioritize since this affects billing notices in their UX.

dmitri: FYI — no auth or latency errors reported in these hits, just output prefix. Logging shows no throttles.

ella: Quick update: repro on v2.3.2 shows the "Note:" preface. v2.3.1 call returns clean summary with no preface. So regression confirmed.

kyle: OK — escalate to eng-runtime and model-onboarding. Tagging with potential cause: system-prompt-preserve-flag misapplied in kernel selection.

maya: I'll send the customer a short status update: we confirmed regression, collecting exact mitigation ETA. Ask them if they can roll back SDK to avoid workaround.

dmitri: I'll open an internal incident and attach logs + request ids.

support-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-198 (service-impact: low). Notifying eng-runtime and eng-ml channels.

ella: Follow-up tasks: 1) eng-runtime to bisect v2.3.2 changes 2) eng-ml to check model weight/compilation flags 3) CS to collect any more examples from customer for regression tests.

kyle: I'll start a PR to add a temporary server-side filter to strip accidental leading prefaces for routes flagged as 'order_summary' until we get a proper fix. Will post PR link. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll keep Acme updated and paste any further examples here.
